## Summary

Describe the change and why it belongs in Omni Icon Vault.

## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes
- [ ] `python -m compileall -q install.py uninstall.py omni.py tools scripts tests` passes
- [ ] New icon sources are pinned and documented in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`
- [ ] No downloaded `vendor/`, cache, private favicons or proprietary icon assets are included
